description: Returns the zero-based index into <dataType> value of subString. If subString is not found, -1 is returned.

parameters.description: Optional start index for search if different than start of string.
parameters.name: startIndex

array.brief: Index of the first array entry equal to a value
array.description: Return the index of the first entry of array equal to searchElement, searching forward from fromIndex, or -1. Values are compared as includes compares them: by value (equal arrays and objects match), and NaN is found, so includes(a, v) is always index_of(a, v) >= 0.

parameters.description: Index to start the search at. Negative counts from the end. At or past the end, nothing is found. Default 0.
parameters.name: fromIndex

returns.description: Zero-based index of subString or -1 if not found.
